title.zh: 导出分轨时按你实际听到的混音状态导出
title.en: Stem export now honours the mixer state you are actually hearing

highlights.zh: 修好：导出分轨没有带上实时的静音/独奏/音量/声像，而是从 pattern 重新推导——按 S 独奏后导出的结果可能和你听到的不一致。现在直接取当前引擎的实时状态。
highlights.en: Fixed: stem export did not carry the live mute/solo/volume/pan and re-derived them from the pattern, so what you exported after pressing S could differ from what you heard.
